description: This file contains test functions for the rate limiting feature in the Mattermost server, including creation of rate limiter settings, testing rate limiter initialization success and failure, and generating request keys based on different configurations.

methods.name: genRateLimitSettings
methods.description: Generates rate limit settings with specified parameters for testing.

methods.name: TestNewRateLimiterSuccess
methods.description: Tests successful creation of rate limiter instances with valid settings.

methods.name: TestNewRateLimiterFailure
methods.description: Tests failure scenarios when creating rate limiters with invalid settings.

methods.name: TestGenerateKey
methods.description: Tests the generation of rate limiting keys based on request attributes and settings.

methods.name: TestGenerateKey_TrustedHeader
methods.description: Tests key generation when using trusted proxy headers.
